schema: CREATE TABLE EVENT ( EVENT_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY, EVENT_NAME TEXT ); CREATE TABLE BUDGET ( BUDGET_ID TEXT PRIMARY KEY, CATEGORY TEXT, AMOUNT INT, LINK_TO_EVENT TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (LINK_TO_EVENT) REFERENCES EVENT(EVENT_ID) );
correct_query: SELECT SUM(T2.amount), T2.category FROM EVENT AS T1 INNER JOIN BUDGET AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'April Speaker' ORDER BY T2.amount, T1.event_id NULLS LAST, T2.budget_id NULLS LAST;

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT category, SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) AS total_budgeted FROM BUDGET JOIN EVENT ON BUDGET.link_to_event = EVENT.event_id WHERE EVENT.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY category ORDER BY total_budgeted ASC, category NULLS LAST;
